headline: UPDATE - Woodward Appoints Paxton McVoy as Chief Information Officer
summary: Woodward Appoints Paxton McVoy as Chief Information Officer Paxton McVoy to join Woodward as CIO FORT COLLINS, Colo., Oct. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Woodward (NASDAQ: WWD), a global leader in aerospace and industrial energy control solutions, today announced the appointment of Paxton McVoy as Executive Vice President and Chief Information Officer (CIO), effective Oct. 19, 2026. He will join the company's Executive Leadership Team, reporting directly to Chief Executive Officer Chip Blankenship
